name: calc_irr
description:
Internal rate of return of a cash flow series (the rate where NPV is zero), found by bisection between -50% and 500% per period. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {cash_flows, irr}: irr in percent per period, 4 decimals.
Inputs (* required): cash_flows* (array of numbers, first flow at time 0; expects a negative investment followed by positive flows, a rate outside -50%..500% is not found).
For value at a known rate use calc_npv.
Example: {"cash_flows": [-1000, 300, 400, 500]}

cash_flows.description: Cash flows from time 0, usually a negative investment first

irr.description: Internal rate of return per period
